column1: # Measured seconds per top-level test in backend/internal/storage/sqlite, read by
# .github/scripts/sqlite-race-shard.sh to balance the sqlite-race CI shards.
# Only the ratios matter: the script splits by relative weight, not by the limit.
# Measured 2026-11-11 on Linux amd64 (20 cores, shared load), Go race build,
# umask 022, TZ=UTC, LANG=C.UTF-8; whole package took 2280 s.
# Format: <test name><TAB><seconds, integer, at least 1>. Tests missing here get
# the mean weight, and lines for tests that no longer exist are ignored.
# Regenerate (from backend/) when a shard nears 15 minutes again:

#   jq -r 'select((.Action=="pass" or .Action=="fail") and .Test != null and (.Test|contains("/")|not)) | "\(.Test)\t\(.Elapsed|ceil|if . < 1 then 1 else . end)"' /tmp/sqlite-race.json | LC_ALL=C sort
